content: Sǝ tǝla ki Bitlus isǝ Yahaya abidla ɗǝ mi'dlǝtl shilǝn
Lǝɓasi, nǝ mi'kina ki ɓutti dlabi ki libi ki Lya nǝ Sadukiyawa is mbǝ ma' Bitlus nǝ Yahaya asi ge' shilǝn nǝ mbalǝn.
Is lyau mbadli nǝ mi' kushti ki Yesu tǝngaki si kulci' mbalǝn, tǝn hillya ki Yesu ge' mi' mǝshti.
Is gop ki Bitlus nǝ Yahaya is idlasi sai nǝ lu acili tǝngaki su' kǝn ɓali.
Amma ginǝ kum shilǝn ki Bitlus is ndǝ'nǝnali u; diɓǝltwasǝn sa tǝla zangu nantam.
Lu cilisi mi'kinawasǝn nǝ kolsiwasǝn nǝ mi'bǝtl lashti zhil ki Musa is ma a Ulshelima.
Nǝ Hanana bal lǝɓa ki Lya ti alǝbi nǝ Kayapa nǝ Yahaya nǝ Iskandali nǝ mus gǝskǝ ki bali ki bas lǝɓasi ki Lya,
Nǝs mbǝl ki Bitlus nǝ Yahaya akina u is gop ngepsi: “Nǝ ndǝltu kǝni ko nǝ shin u kǝn, ki pǝltin nǝgu?”
Bitlus, ki ikǝni nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya, i' ulsisu: “Kini gumsisi nǝ kolsi!
Ki takimibi asǝti tǝn ki ngepmǝnmi tǝn ze' ulnǝ pǝli dakǝl mulu nǝ tu' imi kǝnti ndoɗa,
manǝnngu, kinǝ mus mbalǝn ki Isla'ila: Mul gu nǝ ki dlǝli kinawakǝn ki ndoki u nǝ shin ki Yesu almasihu Mulnazalat, gunǝ tolǝnti tǝn gadlǝnnga u guni Lya tlǝlti ɗǝ ge' mi'mǝshtu,
Yesu tiki,

content.text: iddǝm zǝnnga ki zoki ki kǝpbi.’

content: Peti kǝn mbidli ma mulunwai, kuma shinwonɗawai guni bǝldli a lya nǝ atli nǝ ge' mbalǝn adǝplǝɓa hwel ma'ti tǝnmbi peti.”
Nǝs yen ndǝtl ki mbatl ki Bitlus nǝ Yahaya u, is mani sa pǝl lashtiwai, mi'lǝshi usun kǝni ɗaɗanu, is kum ngaptibi is mansi mbalǝn gi teɗi ne' Yesu siɗa.
Amma nǝs yen mulnǝs ndokǝltu ki dlǝli nesi u, is hwol ulki dlǝmi.
Ngo' nǝnǝgu is bǝlsi zhil ki sǝ'peki ɗǝ bidla nǝ sǝ'shilǝn nǝ yelsǝni u,
is usu, “yakǝn tǝn pǝlin nǝ mbalǝnyi? Mus mi'dǝp a Ulshelima sǝ mani sa pǝlin ulki gagashinti, tu'imi kǝntǝn pǝlin nǝ mbalǝn i u mǝkǝn ma'ussu sa pǝl ulǝn wai.
Amma tǝngagi ɓa ulisi mbǝl du'tǝnki ge' mbalǝn, tǝn dǝlǝsi kǝm bǝs shilǝn nǝ mulin a ge' shin u nuwai.”
Iki is takisi bi te' ɗaɗanu is dǝlisi kǝm bǝs shilǝn ko kushti ge' shin ki Yesu nuwai.
Amma Bitlus nǝ Yahaya is pallisi shilǝn is usu, “Shilǝn ki Lya kǝn tǝn bǝliya ko gwakǝn? Dambǝlǝn kini.
Miɓo, mǝkǝn ma'dǝb shot tǝn ulnǝn yeni u nǝ ulnǝn kumi uwai.”
Kal ki samatisi i, is za'si, tǝngaki sahwol kan u nǝ si'hwotisi ishɗa u i tǝngaki mbalǝn, mus malǝn si natl Lya tǝngaki ulnǝ nda u.
Mul gu nǝ pǝli' ulki gagashinti ki ndokǝltu ta bǝl hwon kutl lǝbi upsi kali.
I mi' bǝtl Yesu kal Shilǝn nǝ Lya
Nǝs za'ki Bitlus nǝ Yahaya u, is lǝma' mbalǝnwasǝn, is palisi shilǝn u nǝ lǝɓasi ne' mi'kina pisi u.
Si ɗaɗanu nǝ kumti nǝgu, is tlǝl yali musswasǝn nǝ mbatl nǝm asi shilǝn nǝ Lya, is usu, “Lya mulnalti,” ki pǝl lya nǝ atli nǝ bal mali, nǝ mus ulnǝ giɓi u.
Ki shilǝn tu'ma' Yal ki mbatl ki Lya nǝ tubi ki zheliwagi, bwasinǝn Dauda

content.text: “ ‘Yalakiɗa ginǝ bǝ Yahudawawai u imbatl lewisi? Mbalǝn ɗaɗanu is dambǝl ulnǝ ɗa baliwai u?
Gumsi ki dǝp lǝɓa is kǝndǝ gǝski dlati, Mi'kǝndǝdlom is maga, is nge Lya, nǝ Almasihuwasi ɗaɗanu.’

content: “Bali nǝguɗa Hilidus nǝ Buntus Bilatus sa maga i age' gatlu ne' ginǝ ba Yahudawai u nǝ mbalǝn ki Isla'ila si dutu' nǝ Yesu zheli wagi mul guunti, gunǝ' palti Almasihu u.
Sa domga i tǝngaki sǝppǝl mus ulnǝ kǝndǝ tǝn ndǝltwagi nǝ lyamtiwagi tǝnda u.
Nǝguni, Lya, yani si lyap hane'mi kyautǝn, bǝtl zhelisiwagi ndǝtl ki mbadli ki dlǝp shilǝnwagi nǝ ndǝtl ki mbatli,
ta' tohwagi ki ndokǝtl mbalǝn, apǝl ulki gagashinti nǝ lwaɗi tu'ma' shinki zheliwagi guu Yesu.”
Kalki sa shilǝn nǝ Lya i, lu u nǝs domga u igo' nyapti. I mus is ikǝnsi nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya, is gop dlǝp shilǝn ki Lya bǝ nǝ ɓantwai.
Mi'bǝtl Yesu kal la' Koyanngi wasǝn idǝm Nǝm
Mus dopga ginǝ ɗǝ duk nǝ Yesu u, ko yangiwasǝn nǝm kǝnǝ, mbadlwasǝn nǝm, mulǝn ɗa tǝ' usu ulkǝ tohwasi gwaskǝn nǝ gwaswai, koyangni mus gwasǝn kǝni.
I mi'shinkǝn ndakina nǝ dlǝmi'mbalǝn ɗaɗanu tǝnpatl ki Yesu kami ndǝ'ti ki shilǝn mul ndǝlti tǝn hillya ki mulban Yesu ge' mi'mǝshti. Ulkǝ zo'ki mul nalti tǝn kowon ngi ge'si,
hal ma mul hwol ulǝn ɗa ge'siwai, tǝngaki mus mi'gu ko libi sa ulitaka i, is mbǝl ulpisi,
is zi' akina ɗǝ mi'shikǝn, i bwasi kowonngi nda'ce nǝ ulkipǝliwasi.
Age nǝgu iki Yusupu, mul Balawiye, gǝswasi mul ki tsibilin Kublus, gunǝ mi'shinkǝn ɗǝ mbetti ki Balnaba, (ikǝ mul ndǝtl mbadli),
i' ul guwastaka, immbǝl ulpisi i'zi akina ɗǝ mi'shikǝn.
